proofUses.reason: The proof integrates h e^{-ht} up to X and applies Tonelli; it invokes no other wiki assertion.
Both directions start from the tail integral for one minus the Laplace transform (LTJ1); the forward direction uses dominated convergence and the converse uses moment convergence and monotonicity.
The proof uses critical extinction (BFM4), the critical generating-function asymptotic (OVG9) and Karamata's Tauberian theorem for regularly varying tails (SLGY) with alpha=1/2.
